@startuml
title View 2 - Core classes for seat booking (controller + entity)
skinparam classAttributeIconSize 0

class ReservationManager <<singleton>> {
  +makeReservation(ReservationRequestDTO): ReservationDTO
  +cancelReservation(reservationId, studentId)
  +performCheckIn(reservationId, studentId)
  +manageReservationEnd()
  +getReservationHistory(studentId)
  ~setAssignmentStrategy(AssignmentStrategy)
  -resolveRoom / resolveArea / resolveTimeSlot
  -validateSeatInArea / validateUniqueness
  -selectSeat / createAndSave / notifyReservation
}
interface AssignmentStrategy { +selectSeat(List<Seat>): Seat }
class FirstAvailableAssignment
class StudyRoomManager <<singleton>> {
  +getAvailableTimeSlots(roomId, date)
  +getRoomDetail(roomId, timeSlotId, date): RoomDetailDTO
}
class NotificationManager <<singleton>> {
  +update(Reservation)
  +sendNotification(recipients, message)
  +sendReminders()
}
interface Observer { +update(Reservation) }
interface NotificationService { +sendNotification(List<UserDTO>, String) }
class NotificationServiceAdapter
class ExternalEmailGateway

abstract class Subject { +attach(Observer); +notifyObservers() }
class Reservation {
  date; stateName (persisted); reminderSent
  CHECK_IN_TOLERANCE_MINUTES = 10
  +cancelReservation()  <<6h window>>
  +performCheckIn()
  +manageEnd()
  +setState(ReservationState)
  +validateActiveReservationForCurrentDate()
}
interface ReservationState { cancel; checkIn; manageEnd; getStatusEnum }
class ActiveState
class ConfirmedState
class CancelledState
class ExpiredState
class CompletedState
class Seat { +isAvailable(date, TimeSlot) }
class Area { type; +getAvailableSeats(date, TimeSlot) }
class StudyRoom { active; +isOpenOnDate(date); +getScheduledTimeSlots(date) }
class TimeSlot { startTime; endTime; +getLabel() }
class Student { +hasActiveOrConfirmedReservationForDateAndSlot(date, label) }
class ReservationRegistry <<singleton>> {
  +saveReservation; +update; +findById
  +findReservationsBySeat(seatId, date, slotId)
  +getEndingReservations(); {static} occupiesSlot(Reservation)
}
class StudyRoomRegistry <<singleton>> {
  +findRoomById; +findAreaById; +findSeatById
  +getSeatsForArea; +getAreasForRoom
}
class UserRegistry <<singleton>>
class PersistenceManager

ReservationManager --> AssignmentStrategy
FirstAvailableAssignment ..|> AssignmentStrategy
ReservationManager ..> ReservationRegistry
ReservationManager ..> StudyRoomRegistry
ReservationManager ..> UserRegistry
ReservationManager ..> NotificationManager
StudyRoomManager ..> StudyRoomRegistry
NotificationManager ..|> Observer
NotificationManager --> NotificationService
NotificationServiceAdapter ..|> NotificationService
NotificationServiceAdapter --> ExternalEmailGateway
Reservation --|> Subject

Reservation --> ReservationState : status

ConfirmedState ..|> ReservationState
CancelledState ..|> ReservationState
ExpiredState ..|> ReservationState
CompletedState ..|> ReservationState

Reservation "*" --> "1" TimeSlot
Reservation "*" --> "1" Student

StudyRoom "1" o-- "*" TimeSlot

Area ..> StudyRoomRegistry
ReservationRegistry --> PersistenceManager
StudyRoomRegistry --> PersistenceManager
UserRegistry --> PersistenceManager
@enduml

@startuml
title View 3 - makeReservation runtime flow (POST /api/reservations/create)
actor Student
participant "app.js / Swing\nReservationSummary" as UI
participant ReservationController as RC
participant LibraryFacade as F
participant ReservationManager as RM
participant StudyRoomRegistry as SRR
participant Area
participant Seat
participant ReservationRegistry as RR
participant Reservation
participant NotificationManager as NM
participant NotificationServiceAdapter as NSA

Student -> UI : confirm (room, area, seatId or 0, date, slot)
UI -> RC : create(...)   [Swing calls Facade directly]
RC -> F : makeReservation(ReservationRequestDTO)
F -> RM : makeReservation(request)
RM -> RM : resolveStudent (UserRegistry)
RM -> SRR : findRoomById ; findAreaById
RM -> RM : check room active/open, slot not started,\narea in room, seat in area
RM -> RM : synchronized(this)
RM -> RM : validateUniqueness\n(Student.hasActiveOrConfirmedReservation...)
RM -> Area : getAvailableSeats(date, slot)
Area -> SRR : getSeatsForArea
loop each seat
  Area -> Seat : isAvailable(date, slot)
  Seat -> RR : findReservationsBySeat
end
alt seatId > 0
  RM -> Seat : isAvailable (re-check)
else seatId == 0
  RM -> RM : assignmentStrategy.selectSeat(available)\n(FirstAvailableAssignment)
end
RM -> Reservation : new, set date/slot/seat/student, setState(ActiveState)
RM -> RR : saveReservation
RM -> Reservation : attach(NM) ; notifyObservers()
Reservation -> NM : update(reservation)
NM -> NSA : sendNotification (email; failures only logged)
RM --> F : ReservationDTO
F --> RC
RC --> UI : JSON
note over RM : IllegalArgument/IllegalState exceptions\nare mapped by RestExceptionHandler
@enduml
E
cat > README.md <<'E'
# Seat booking: architecture views

Source: `JavaProject/src/main/java/it/unina/reservations` (Spring Boot + Swing, JPA, layered boundary/controller/entity).

- **view-1.puml, component view.** Shows the layers and components that take part in booking: the web UI and Swing wizard, the REST controllers, `LibraryFacade`, `ReservationManager` and `StudyRoomManager`, the entities and registries, persistence, and the notification path. It also shows the scheduler that expires reservations. Use it first to see where a change belongs and what it touches.
- **view-2.puml, class view.** Shows the classes you will edit: `ReservationManager`, the `AssignmentStrategy` seam for seat choice, `Reservation` with its State classes and Observer link, and `Seat`, `Area`, `StudyRoom` and `TimeSlot`. It also shows the registries and the notification adapter. It shows where each rule lives. Availability is in `Seat.isAvailable` and `Area.getAvailableSeats`. The cancel window and check-in tolerance are in `Reservation`. Status transitions are in the `*State` classes.
- **view-3.puml, sequence view.** Shows the `makeReservation` call chain from UI to database and notification. It covers validation order, the `synchronized` block that guards against double booking, the seat auto-assignment when `seatId == 0`, saving, and the observer notification.

Notes for changes: the Swing UI and `app.js` both go through `LibraryFacade`/REST, so add new operations to `LibraryFacade` and the controller. Seat availability is computed from reservations in `ReservationRegistry.occupiesSlot`, so there is no separate seat-status table.
E
